user.title: Which UniFi Network?
user.description: You have more than one UniFi Network integration. Choose the one whose clients should be handed to Home Assistant's DHCP discovery. Each is shown by its name and controller address.

data_description.unifi_entry_id: The UniFi Network integration whose clients are used.

networks.title: Which networks?
networks.description: Reading from **{unifi}**. Select the networks whose clients should be handed to Home Assistant's DHCP discovery, so devices there are discovered too. Nothing is selected by default.

data_description.networks: Clients on these networks are fed to DHCP discovery. At least one is required.

abort.no_networks: No networks could be found for this UniFi Network integration.
